Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: Lower abdominal pain x2 days.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Pain location: below the umbilicus; burning quality; gradual onset, increasing; constant.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Pain location: below the umbilicus; burning quality; gradual onset, increasing; constant.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Associated: hot and sweaty sensation; mild nausea; no vomiting.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Associated: hot and sweaty sensation; mild nausea; no vomiting.

Assessment.content: Acute lower abdominal pain with urinary symptoms (likely lower UTI vs other GU/GI etiology) vs pregnancy-related consideration.
Assessment.source_text: 1) Acute lower abdominal pain with urinary symptoms (likely lower UTI vs other GU/GI etiology) vs pregnancy-related consideration.

Assessment.content: Pregnancy risk to be excluded with pregnancy testing despite Implanon.
Assessment.source_text: 2) Pregnancy risk to be excluded with pregnancy testing despite Implanon.

Assessment.content: Overall plan to treat empirically while awaiting tests; ensure safety with follow-up.

Plan_of_Care.content: Encourage increased fluids; cranberry juice optional for urinary symptoms.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Fluids: Encourage increased fluids; cranberry juice optional for urinary symptoms.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange pregnancy test to exclude pregnancy (per clinician plan to test later; perform now if feasible).

Plan_of_Care.content: Script sent to pharmacy; start antibiotics today.

Follow_up_Information.content: Return in a few days or sooner if symptoms worsen (fever, vomiting, worsening pain).

Follow_up_Information.content: Seek urgent care if pain worsens, fever hot/ sweating persists, or vomiting occurs.
